system.description:
HALFLING

Courage comes more easily when there is someone beside you who still feels like home.
While you are within 10 feet of at least one conscious ally, you gain a +1-racial bonus to saving throws against Fear, possession, Soul Drain and effects with the Soul trait.
This bonus does not increase because additional allies are within range.

Works automatically: +1 racial is offered on saves against Fear, possession, Soul Drain and Soul effects — tick when an ally is within 10 feet.

conditionals.label: Hearthward
conditionals.scope: Saving throws against Fear, possession, Soul Drain and Soul-trait effects while a conscious ally is within 10 feet
